entities.summary: Xabier Agirre López was a Spanish administrator and politician. A member of the Basque Nationalist Party, he held important institutional positions both in the Foral Deputation of Álava and in the Basque Parliament. He served as Deputy General of Álava from 2007 to 2011 and president of Araba Buru Batzar from 1983 to 1987 and from 2012 to 2016.
